page.overview:
Who is Thorny?

Thorny is a supporting character in A Bug's Life.

Thorny is a short, grumpy ant who is a member of the Council of Ants. He usually carries an abacus to calculate the number of seeds that have been harvested so far. He often stands watch to see if Hopper and his gang are coming. Thorny dislikes Flik due to of his clumsiness and his inventions. However, by the end of the film, Thorny realizes he has misjudged Flik. He even uses Flik's grass seed harvester, as do the rest of the colony.
